CompiledPlan.v1.description:
`CompiledPlan.v1` — the immutable plan produced by the authoritative Rust
compiler (D3/D4): normalised graph, closed capabilities, semantic
digests. Frontier stub — fields authored in the compiler phase.
CompiledPlan.v1.title: CompiledPlan.v1

EnforcementKind.description:
`Documented` vs `Enforced` — the AM-2 enforcement axis. See the module docs
for the exact meaning: `Enforced` requires a resolvable [`MechanismAnchor`].

oneOf.description: Carried by prompt/process discipline or a bypassable/spec-level check.

A mechanical gate on the authoritative path blocks the process on
violation under normal operation (see the module docs — NOT a claim of
impossible-to-bypass; documented exemptions/scope exist).

MechanismAnchor.description:
Where an `Enforced` element's mechanism lives: a repo-relative `file` and a
`needle` token that must appear inside it. The test layer resolves every
anchor, so an `Enforced` marking whose mechanism vanished fails loudly
instead of lying (P72 anti-score / gate-discriminant discipline).

file.description: Repo-relative path from the workspace root (e.g. a hook or `gates.rs`).

needle.description: A stable token that must be present in `file` for the marking to hold.

ProcessElement.description:
One named element of the process (a role, a mode, a gate, or a hook) with
its enforcement marking, optional mechanism, and the source that declares it.

mechanism.description: Present iff `enforcement == Enforced`; names a resolvable mechanism.

source.description: Which digested source declares this element.

title.description: Short human title from the source.

ProcessInvariants.description:
Boolean process invariants extracted from the sources. Each is a fact the
runtime can assert against, not a knob.

codex_output_rewritable.description:
Codex output is raw, never rewritten by the driver
(`PROCESS.md`; `AGENT_SYSTEM.md §5.3`).

gate_check_is_authority.description:
`gate-check` is a diagnostic, never an authority (`AGENT_SYSTEM.md §2`;
`RRV_FACTORY_CONTRACT.md §2`).

pass_pending_committable.description:
`PASS-PENDING` is never a committable verdict (`PROCESS.md` Phase Commit
Finality; `AGENT_SYSTEM.md §5.2`).

reconciliation_required_before_pass.description:
The final `## Verdict: PASS` is only written after Codex reconciliation
(`AGENT_SYSTEM.md §5.2`).

SourceDigest.description:
The BLAKE3 digest of one source, as embedded in the profile. `blake3` is the
lowercase hex digest of the LF/BOM-canonicalised bytes (see [`canonicalise`]).

blake3.description: Lowercase hex BLAKE3 of the canonicalised source bytes.

SourceId.description:
The authoritative prose sources the profile is extracted from and bound to.
Each variant's [`SourceId::path`] is repo-relative from the workspace root.

oneOf.description:
`docs/agent/PROCESS.md` — the vendor-neutral sprint workflow: the
Guarantee Matrix (`G1`-`G10`), the 9-section commit body, `PASS-PENDING`,
the three verification blocks.

`docs/agent/AGENT_SYSTEM.md` — the role registry (9), the lifecycle modes
(10), the preflight scans, the audit tracks, the gate verdicts.

`docs/agent/RRV_FACTORY_CONTRACT.md` — the authority order
`process > RRV > Factory` and the "no downstream authority" principle.

`docs/factory/FACTORY_GATES.md` — the publication pipeline `FG0`-`FG10`
plus the non-delegable `FG-CSP-authoring`.

`.claude/hooks/phase-precommit-lightcheck.sh` — the mechanical precommit
gate (Phase-A design review, staging coherence, preflight presence, Codex
artifact).

`.claude/hooks/phase-auditor-gate.sh` — the mechanical gate that blocks a
phase commit unless the final review reads `## Verdict: PASS`.

audit_tracks.description:
The nine audit-gate tracks (`AGENT_SYSTEM.md §5.4`). Note: `README §7.1`
Cas A lists an extended 11-track canon (adds `J`/`K` standing); the bound
authority here is `AGENT_SYSTEM.md §5.4`, so the count is 9.

commit_body_sections.description: The nine mandatory commit-body sections (`PROCESS.md` Phase Commit Finality).

process_gates.description:
The process gates `G1`-`G10` (`PROCESS.md` Guarantee Matrix). `G1` and
`G5` are `Enforced` (blocked by the authoritative `agentctl` gate,
mirrored by the Claude lightcheck); the rest — including `G8`, which the
authoritative gate only WARNs — are `Documented`.

publication_gates.description:
The publication gates `FG0`-`FG10` plus `FG-CSP-authoring`
(`FACTORY_GATES.md`). Only `FG-CSP-authoring` is `Enforced` (truly
non-delegable: publish + redeploy); the rest — including `FG8`, which is
skipped on the redeploy path and by the N0 exception — are `Documented`.

sources.description: The BLAKE3 digests of the six sources, in [`SourceId::ALL`] order.

verification_blocks.description: The three full verification blocks (`PROCESS.md` Quality Bar).

FactoryProcessProfile.v1.title: FactoryProcessProfile.v1

RunEvent.v1.description:
`RunEvent.v1` — one append-only run-journal entry (D3), primary key
`(run_id, sequence)`, with an idempotency key on effects. The journal is
the source of truth for durable replay. Frontier stub — envelope authored
in the run-store phase.
RunEvent.v1.title: RunEvent.v1

SBFBAgentDefinition.v1.description:
`SBFBAgentDefinition.v1` — one bounded agent island inside a pack (D4):
prompt, policies, budgets, declared dependencies. `handoff` (explicit
transfer) is distinct from `agent.as_tool`. Frontier stub — fields
authored in the workflow-language phase.
SBFBAgentDefinition.v1.title: SBFBAgentDefinition.v1

SBFBPromptAgentPack.v1.description:
`SBFBPromptAgentPack.v1` — root of the signed, portable prompt+agent pack
(D2). Carries the workflow graph, agent definitions, prompts, pinned
schemas, requested (never granted) capabilities, evals and provenance;
`layout/` stays outside the semantic digest. Frontier stub — fields
authored in the pack-format phase.
SBFBPromptAgentPack.v1.title: SBFBPromptAgentPack.v1

SBFBWorkflowGraph.v1.description:
`SBFBWorkflowGraph.v1` — the data-flow workflow graph (D4): typed ports,
bounded `repeat`, subworkflows, `human.review`, `wait.signal`. The signed
graph IS the plan; no LLM extends it. Frontier stub — node profile
authored in the workflow-language phase.
SBFBWorkflowGraph.v1.title: SBFBWorkflowGraph.v1

WorkflowPublicProjection.v1.description:
`WorkflowPublicProjection.v1` — the allow-listed public projection of a
workflow consumed by RRV (D1/D4): only whitelisted fields leave the node;
RRV neither launches nor mutates a run. Frontier stub — fields authored in
the publication/RRV phase.
WorkflowPublicProjection.v1.title: WorkflowPublicProjection.v1
